description: Source code for character encoding detection, defining character ranges for various encodings and a function to determine possible encodings for a given character.

classes.name: CharRange
classes.description: Structure representing a range of character codes with 'first' and 'last' bounds.

methods.name: charMatchesEncoding
methods.description: Performs binary search to check if a character code falls within any of the specified encoding ranges.

methods.name: findPossibleEncodings
methods.description: Determines which character encodings a given character code could belong to, returning a bitmask of possible encodings.
